senses.def: A river in Powys and Monmouthshire, Wales, that empties into the Severn at Newport.
A town and community with a town council in Monmouthshire, Wales, on this river (OS grid ref SO3700).
An industrial location and coastal wetland in Nash community, City of Newport, Wales (OS grid ref ST3383).

A member of a group of irregular soldiers in Habsburg Croatia who inhabited the eastern Adriatic coast and surrounding territories during the Ottoman wars in Europe, and fought a guerrilla war against the Ottomans.
A quarter in Istanbul, Turkey, formerly known as Scutari.
